scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the washer inlet-screen cleaning and run the waiting linen load before the evening pickup.
Emerging Need: The cleaning attempt is underway, but reopening the cold-water shutoff fails and the washer cannot fill or continue without plumbing help.
Decision Context: Stored service guidance distinguishes a tenant-safe rinse from a cracked valve blockage and defines the approval path and cutoff for same-day repair.
Consequence: Once the routing board closes, the washer remains unusable for the linen deadline and the valve stays shut until a later work window.

parameter.title: Clean linen pickup
parameter.description: Tessa's cousin is picking up the freshly washed guest bedding and towels from the townhouse.

parameter.content: Starting the washer inlet-screen rinse now: both supply valves turned off cleanly, the cold hose is off, a towel is under the hookup, and the linen load is waiting.
Cold screen is rinsed and the hose is reattached, but the cold shutoff handle cracked when I tried reopening it. It just spins, the valve stays shut, and the washer stops at fill.

parameter.subject: Saturday plumbing routing board closed
parameter.body: The 13:30 same-day plumbing dispatch board is now locked. New approved plumbing items received after this notice will be assigned to the next business-day work queue unless an active leak is reported by phone.
